thread:
Nina: Drafting a short 'goal clarity sheet' for managers + ICs — helpful when prepping 1:1s or skip-levels. Need copy/paste templates.
Omar: Useful. Include a 2-line rubric for signal vs noise on metrics.
Nina: Proposed template: 1) Goal (one clear sentence). 2) Why now (one phrase). 3) Success signal -> metric + target. 4) Worst-case risk (one line). 5) Current blocker / ask.
Chen: Example (infra): 'Cut inference cost per 1k tokens by 25% by Q2 to improve margins. Why now: rising inference spend. Success signal -> cost/1k down 25%. Risk -> latency regressions. Ask -> profiling time + canary budget.'
Priya: Example (design/product): 'Improve onboarding NPS from 42 to 60 by end-Q3 to lift activation. Why now: low early retention. Success-> NPS 60. Risk-> signal noise from sampling. Ask-> research participants + analytics event.'
Omar: Add manager micro-prompts to coach: 'What would make us stop early?', 'What minimal experiment validates progress?', 'Who's owning rollout?'.
Nina: Add 30s self-review line: 'Shipped X -> impacted Y (metric), learned Z, next step A.'
People Ops Bot: Saved to drive: https://drive.redwood/goal-clarity-sheet (team read).
Nina: I'll fold into OKR kit and add as alternate wording options. Ping here for edits.
Chen: Small edit: change "Why now" to "Business priority" for exec-facing versions.
Nina: Good call — will create both variants. Closing thread.
